description: Locate a card by name across all holdings. Returns, per stack: physical location (where it is RIGHT NOW), quantity, free (unallocated) copies, and every allocation with deck, status (staged = earmarked but physically elsewhere; sleeved = physically in the deck) and shared disclosure. The name may be in any language Scryfall prints: a stack found that way carries read_as ("Foudre → Lightning Bolt"), say it. Always repeat the shared/proxy disclosures to the user.

name.description: Card name or substring, in English or another language

name: where_is

allocations.description: Each deck claim in words, with its status (staged: earmarked, elsewhere; sleeved: in the deck) and any shared disclosure

card.description: The card, its printing and finish in words; ", PROXY" when the stack is proxies

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

is_proxy.description: The stack is proxies, not real cards: always say so

physically_in.description: Where the stack physically is right now

read_as.description: "Foudre → Lightning Bolt": the stack was found by a name in another language; say it

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

shared.description: A claim on the stack is shared with another deck: name every deck in `allocations`

title: Where is
